approval_case.title: Give Claude a fresh neutral packet
approval_case.situation: Codex recommended a rollout. Hao asks for an independent Claude view using three trusted files.
approval_case.hao_request: Get an independent Claude view before we decide.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Start a fresh Claude review rather than resume prior context. Ask one neutral question about material rollout risks, attach only proposal.md, canary.json, and rollback.md, require evidence for each risk, and stop where those files cannot resolve a claim. Exclude Codex's recommendation so it does not anchor the independent review. Wait for the terminal result and inspect its artifacts before deciding.
